description: For a sequence of nonempty candidate sets, the empty history is valid and every valid finite history admits a valid one-term extension.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.WeakerChoice.selection_histories_serial.{u} {α : Type u} (A : ℕ → Set α)
  (hA : ∀ (n : ℕ), (A n).Nonempty) :
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.WeakerChoice.SelectionHistory A [] ∧
    ∀ (s : List α),
      Lemmatheca.SetTheory.WeakerChoice.SelectionHistory A s →
        ∃ t,
          Lemmatheca.SetTheory.WeakerChoice.SelectionHistory A t ∧
            Lemmatheca.SetTheory.WeakerChoice.OneTermExtension s t
